description: This file contains functions for processing and logging Signed Certificate Timestamps (SCTs), including encoding data in Base64, converting SCTs to dictionaries for logging, and generating log parameters.

methods.name: SetBinaryData
methods.description: Encodes a string in Base64 and sets it in a dictionary with a specified key.

methods.name: SCTToDictionary
methods.description: Converts a SignedCertificateTimestamp object and its verification status into a dictionary for logging.

methods.name: SCTListToPrintableValues
methods.description: Converts a list of SCTs and their statuses into a list of dictionaries for logging.

methods.name: NetLogSignedCertificateTimestampParams
methods.description: Creates a dictionary of SCTs for logging.

methods.name: NetLogRawSignedCertificateTimestampParams
methods.description: Creates a dictionary with raw SCT data from various sources for logging.
